item.title: US Army places $11M bet on Austin-based GPS alternative Tern
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Tern has described its tech as "Google Maps for the battlefield."

item.title: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures, sources say.

item.title: Automattic’s board forces CEO Matt Mullenweg into leave of absence
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort, Sarah Perez
item.description: Mullenweg said in a company Slack message that it was against his will.

item.title: OpenAI adds a prominent AI doomer to its board of directors
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Paul Christiano, an influential AI researcher focused on alignment, is joining the OpenAI Foundation as a member of its board.

item.title: Massachusetts hits data centers with new clean power rules
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Massachusetts has become the third state in as many months to slap new restrictions on data center development.

item.title: Apple’s new CEO is reviving a Steve Jobs strategy from 25 years ago
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: John Ternus made the case in his first keynote as Apple CEO that the iPhone isn't going anywhere.

item.title: Apple Watch’s new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Apple says its new watches won’t save raw audio, but features that can transcribe recent speech and summarize ambient conversations raise new questions about consent, privacy, and how people behave when they know they could always be recorded.

item.title: Everything Apple announced at its fall iPhone event, from the foldable iPhone Duo to an always-listening Apple Watch
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The main event was the tech giant's highly anticipated first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo.

item.title: There are new shiny iPhones, so Apple is making you pay more for older models
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Apple is raising the price of its existing iPhone models by $100, including iPhone 16, iPhone 17, and iPhone Air.

item.title: The hinge for Apple’s new foldable phone was built with AI
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Apple says it used AI and 3D printing in the manufacturing process for its long-awaited foldable phone.

item.title: Apple Watch’s new feature listens to your chats and recaps them
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The Siri Recap feature is similar to other note-taking apps like Granola.

item.title: Harvey hits $15.5B valuation, months after reaching $11B
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: The legal AI startup and VC darling has nearly doubled its valuation in nine months.

item.title: Apple’s revamped Health app will calculate your ‘health age’ and readiness score
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The update uses Apple Intelligence to make better sense of your health data.

item.title: Apple unveils Watch Series 12 and Watch Ultra 4 with an AI upgrade that can recap your day
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Most notably, Apple is taking aim at the growing wave of AI wearables with new "Audio Intelligence" features that let you rewind moments and remember details from daily conversations.

item.title: Apple has a new way to prove your iPhone photos aren’t AI slop
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Apple introduced Apple Reference Image to help users determine whether photos have been edited, including alterations made by AI.

item.title: Apple shows off AirPods 5 with improved active noise cancellation
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: The AirPods 5 support better noise cancellation, Siri AI, and offer volume controls on the stem.

item.title: Apple unveils its first foldable, the iPhone Duo
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Unlike early iterations of foldables, which looked like vertical slabs, Apple adopted a wider form factor that could aid in a better aspect ratio while watching videos when the device is unfolded.

item.title: Apple CEO John Ternus says the best AI device is still the iPhone
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The company also argued that its on-device models offer consumers more privacy.

item.title: Apple launches iPhone 18 Pro with upgraded camera
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro lineup upgrades the camera and comes in burgundy.

item.title: DOJ wants more answers on Fox’s $22B Roku deal
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
